verdict.rationale: Agents can pause to ask questions when they need input, and Omnara offers event webhooks that send JSON POST requests plus a first-party Slack connector. Together these give a plausible way to be alerted. However, no evidence says which events the webhooks emit, or that completion and input-needed states trigger a notification. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of task-completion and input-required notification events, push or Slack alerting for those states, and hands-on corroboration.
